warnings.headline: Status Yellow - Wind and Rain warning for Cork, Waterford
warnings.description:
Spells of heavy rain along with strong and gusty southeast winds.

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Poor visibility
  • Debris, loose objects displaced
